rules.claim: MCP tool schemas load on demand (names ~120 tokens up front); keep tool-search deferral on for large MCP surfaces
Subagents return short summaries; delegate file-heavy reads and verification to keep the main context small

Per-agent model via frontmatter; resolution: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL env > per-invocation > frontmatter > main model; a user-level agents/<name>.md in the instance's config dir shadows a plugin agent of the same name (managed > CLI > project > user > plugin)
settings.json skillOverrides accepts on|name-only|user-invocable-only|off per skill — the durable way to trim plugin skills (survives plugin updates)
CLAUDE.md loads every session and bloat degrades adherence; keep broadly-applicable rules, move conditional knowledge into skills
disable-model-invocation: true removes a skill's model-triggered context cost while keeping /invocation
Cache economics: 0.1x read, 1.25x 5-min write, 2.0x 1-hr write; per-model minimums (Opus 4.8/Sonnet 5 = 1024, Fable 5 = 512, Haiku 4.5 = 4096) silently skip below minimum
Recall degrades as context grows; prefer the smallest high-signal token set via just-in-time loading
Tool Search Tool ~85% token reduction (~77k -> ~8.7k) on large tool surfaces
Programmatic tool calling ~37% context reduction in Anthropic's example (43.6k -> 27.3k)
A 5-server MCP setup costs ~55k tokens up front without deferral
Haiku ~15x cheaper than Opus; simple subagent tasks reportedly equivalent on Haiku
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is undocumented in official docs as of 2026-07-01; never recommend changing it firmly

Repeated whole-artifact rewrites degrade an instruction file over successive passes (context collapse); prefer an ordered set of add/delete/replace edits anchored on exact existing lines, each carrying its own evidence, with a full rewrite as an explicitly-marked exception
